# HOW TO ADD A PROJECT
# 1. Copy this file into projects/ with a short name, e.g. projects/my-project.qmd
#    (files starting with "_" are ignored, so this template never shows up on the site).
# 2. Fill in the fields below and the sections of the page.
# 3. Run `quarto render`. The card appears automatically on the Projects page.

title: "Project title"
description: "One sentence shown on the card."
status: "Ongoing"          # e.g. Ongoing, Completed, Published, Dissertation chapter
period: "2025–present"     # optional
team: "Names of collaborators"   # optional
order: 99                  # position on the Projects page (lower comes first)
home: false                # true = also show this card on the home page
featured: false            # true = show as the "Featured paper" on the home page
draft: true                # remove this line when the page is ready to go online
---
